description: Canonical machine-readable composition matrix. Authored service forms, non-service asks and the device role vocabulary; this JVD declares no role bindings or capability selectors. The dependency-contract projection is written by the build tooling.

aliases: EVPN-VXLAN MAC-VRF with 51 VLANs and IGMP snooping
forms.attachment: Access units on the compute leaves (the ESI-LAG and single-homed server ports) and the VLANs' IRB units, which the Type 5 VRFs route.

aliases: EVPN-VXLAN MAC-VRF with 51 VLANs, IGMP snooping and OISM
forms.attachment: Access units on the storage and services leaves and the VLANs' IRB units, which the Type 5 VRFs route; OISM joins the VLANs to the VRFs' multicast.

aliases: EVPN Type 5 VRF with ten IRB units
forms.attachment: IRB units of the MAC-VRF VLANs and the VRF loopback unit.

aliases: EVPN Type 5 VRF with ten IRB units and DHCP relay
forms.attachment: IRB units of the MAC-VRF VLANs and the VRF loopback unit, which DHCP relay uses as its source.

aliases: EVPN Type 5 VRF with twenty IRB units and DHCP relay
forms.attachment: IRB units of the MAC-VRF VLANs and the VRF loopback unit, which DHCP relay uses as its source.

aliases: EVPN Type 5 VRF with OSPF, PIM and OISM
forms.attachment: IRB units of the MAC-VRF VLANs (one carries OSPF, PIM and the OISM supplemental bridge domain) and the VRF loopback unit.

aliases: Border EVPN Type 5 VRF with eBGP to the external gateway
forms.attachment: The services leaf's attachment unit toward the external gateway and the VRF loopback unit.

aliases: Border EVPN Type 5 VRF with eBGP and ten IRB units
forms.attachment: The attachment unit toward the external gateway, the VLANs' IRB units and the VRF loopback unit.

aliases: Border EVPN Type 5 VRF with eBGP and DHCP relay
forms.attachment: The attachment unit toward the external gateway and the VRF loopback unit, which DHCP relay uses as its source.

aliases: Border EVPN Type 5 VRF with eBGP, twenty IRB units and DHCP relay
forms.attachment: The attachment unit toward the external gateway, the VLANs' IRB units and the VRF loopback unit.

aliases: Border EVPN Type 5 VRF with eBGP, OSPF, PIM and OISM
forms.attachment: The attachment unit toward the external gateway, the VLANs' IRB units (one carries OSPF, PIM and the OISM supplemental bridge domain) and the VRF loopback unit.
